checks.finding: Flower Shield is conditional on each protected Pokemon having any Psychic Energy attached. It does not require Psychic attached to Comfey to protect the other eligible Pokemon.

Comfey now has one Psychic; this qualifies Comfey itself for the condition.
Master Plan card displayed, with Comfey one Psychic.
Hypno did not become Confused message. Hypno has two Psychic, so its own attached Energy satisfies Flower Shield.

checks.inference: Turn 8 Comfey attachment expands protection to Comfey; it does not activate global protection. Turn2 already has at least Drowzee eligible. Ability effect follows the card's per-Pokemon condition, corroborated by which cards display protection icons.
checks.old_claim_relation: The new C8 assertion contradicts the visible card wording. Old turn2 wording is broadly compatible for eligible Pokemon, but should be qualified rather than interpreted as all Pokemon regardless of their Energy.
checks.required_action: Remove claim protection begins globally on turn8. Replace every dynamic restriction that says while Comfey has Psychic Energy with condition on each affected Pokemon's own attached Psychic Energy. Correct turn2/turn8 commentary, C8 conflict descriptions, effects-in-force rows and any derived explanation. Preserve old packet.
